judul_en: Why does cutting onions make you cry?

adegan.vo: [curious] Kenapa motong bawang | bikin nangis? | {p0}A, pedas? | {p1}B, ada gas? | {p2}C, cuma sugesti?
adegan.vo_en: Why does cutting onions | make you cry? | A, it's spicy? | B, there's a gas? | C, it's all in your head?

adegan.vo: [excited] Jawabannya... | {jawab}B, GAS! | [excited] Bawang punya | {besar}senjata kimia! | [whispers] Dan ada bawang yang nggak bikin nangis... | {teaser}di akhir video.
adegan.vo_en: The answer... | B, GAS! | Onions have | a chemical weapon! | And there's an onion that won't make you cry... | at the end of the video.

adegan.vo: [curious] Begini prosesnya: | {l0}saat dipotong, sel bawang pecah. | {l1}Enzimnya mengubah zat belerang... | {l2}jadi gas pemicu air mata. | {l3}Gas itu sampai ke mata, | [surprised] dan air mata keluar | untuk membilasnya!
adegan.vo_en: Here's how it works: | when cut, onion cells burst. | Enzymes turn sulfur compounds... | into a tear-triggering gas. | The gas reaches your eyes, | and tears come out | to wash it away!

adegan.vo: [playful] Mau nggak nangis? | {l0}Dinginkan dulu di kulkas, | {l1}pakai pisau yang tajam, | {l2}dan potong akarnya paling akhir.
adegan.vo_en: Want to stop crying? | Chill it in the fridge first, | use a sharp knife, | and cut the root end last.

adegan.vo: [mischievously] Dan kejutannya: | {k}enzim pelakunya ditemukan | ilmuwan Jepang tahun dua ribu dua. | [excited] {i0}Sekarang sudah ada bawang hasil pemuliaan | yang nggak bikin nangis, | dijual di Amerika dan Inggris!
adegan.vo_en: And the surprise: | the culprit enzyme was found | by Japanese scientists in 2002. | Now there's a specially bred onion | that doesn't make you cry, | sold in the US and the UK!

adegan.vo: [playful] Bawang memang kecil, | tapi senjatanya kimia! | Kirim ke temanmu | yang selalu nangis di dapur!
adegan.vo_en: Onions may be small, | but they pack chemical weapons! | Send this to a friend | who always cries in the kitchen!

fakta.klaim: Saat bawang dipotong, enzim mengubah senyawa belerang menjadi gas pemicu air mata (syn-propanethial-S-oxide); enzim LFS-nya ditemukan 2002.
fakta.klaim_en: Cutting an onion lets enzymes turn sulfur compounds into a tear-triggering gas; the LFS enzyme was identified in 2002.

fakta.klaim: Bawang 'tanpa air mata' hasil pemuliaan sudah dijual di Amerika Serikat dan Inggris.
fakta.klaim_en: Tearless onions from breeding are sold in the US and the UK.

fakta.klaim: Mengurangi air mata: dinginkan bawang ±30 menit, pakai pisau tajam, potong akar paling akhir.
fakta.klaim_en: Fewer tears: chill the onion ~30 min, use a sharp knife, cut the root end last.

sumber.judul: Imai S. et al., An onion enzyme that makes the eyes water, Nature 419:685 (2002)
Sunions: tearless onions (AS sejak musim 2017/18; Inggris lewat Waitrose sejak Jan 2022)
Why do onions make you cry? (tips: dinginkan, pisau tajam, akar terakhir)
